page.overview:
Who is Candy Boss?

He appears to be an orange candy person with light bling hair and a blue business suit. He also wears a red tie.

Candy Boss is seen acting like a stereotypical cutthroat boss. He was very hard on Root Beer Guy for not getting any sales. In spite of this, he never fired Root Beer Guy.
